sections.heading: Game Overview
sections.text: Pharaoh's Vault is a 5-reel, 3-row video slot with 20 fixed paylines. Explore the tomb's hidden chambers and uncover the treasures of the boy king.

sections.heading: Game Information
sections.text:
Volatility: High
Min bet: £0.20
Max bet: £5.00
Max win: 5,000x total bet

sections.heading: Hold & Win Feature
sections.text:
Landing 6 or more Scarab coin symbols triggers the Hold & Win feature. Coins lock in place and the player receives 3 respins. Each new coin resets the respins to 3.
Fill all 15 positions to win the Grand jackpot.

sections.heading: Return to Player
sections.text: The theoretical return to player (RTP) of this game is 96.12%. Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
